summary: Tested the CloudIVR 'Get a number' country pricing, Calls + texting (MultiTEL USA), the eSIM way picker, landing quotes and pricing tabs, fax regression, and the support chat. Backend: 7/7 pytest passed (planAddons BR=25 on every plan, US=0, NL mobile business=0 and others 25; texting/ready US included=true needs10dlc=true; 401 when signed out). Frontend: most flows work: the 89-country picker has no paperwork labels; BR and NL plan cards, breakdowns and checkout totals are right; the UI Brazil purchase on Basic charged $75 and the number appears in My numbers; texting buy US $50 with the 10DLC note and link, BR $75; eSIM way picker; landing plans-mobile and plans-esim, web texting checkout, hero-price-mobile; fax selects are clean. Two real bugs: (1) the country picker labels USA, Canada and UK '· extra monthly charge'. (2) Request-only countries (DE, AT, CR, CY, DK, EC, PY, PE) cannot be bought as a first number: the backend returns 400 extra_number_only, and the price shown has no country charge.

critical.issue: js/cloudivr-web/number-requests.js line 40 still calls phoneConfig.includedIssue(planKey, country, 'local'), which rejects every country outside the plan's free countries. Germany (and AT, CR, CY, DK, EC, PY, PE: all request-only offers) on any plan returns 400 extra_number_only 'A plan comes with a USA, Canada or UK number... Add other countries as an extra number once you have a plan.' This breaks the owner's rule that every country is allowed as a first number. Reproduced in the UI: Germany → Order for $50.00 from wallet → red error.
The price is round2(plan.price) with no planAddon. The country charge ($25) is never added, even though the picker says 'Germany · extra monthly charge'. Billing does not match the label.

ui_bugs.issue: The catalog sends included:'all' for US, CA and GB, but CallsBuy.js line 41 checks c.included === true. As a result, USA, Canada and UK show '· extra monthly charge' instead of '· free with every plan'. Fix: c.included === 'all' || c.included === true.

The PlanPicker gets pick={null} and RequestOrder shows only plan.price, so a request country shows the plain plan price with no '+ country charge' breakdown. This goes against 'shown clearly before paying'.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking Order shows the backend 400 extra_number_only error; a Germany number cannot be bought as a first number

issues: The selected card (aria-checked=true, class civr-trace) looks exactly like the unselected one: same border, shadow and background in computed styles. There is no visible selected state for On your phone / In your browser.

The calls checkout for a Brazil number still offers the 'Add a Texting Number' upsell (checkout-texting-addon, ZIP-based Spenza, $45 first month). Spenza moved to the eSIM page, so this upsell may now be out of place or confusing next to 'Calls + texting'.
USA MultiTEL results are labelled 'Mobile · IL', but the brief says these are USA local numbers. Check the type/label.

design_issues.screen: Landing plans-esim Web texting number card
issues: The card line says 'texts only, in CloudIVR Messages', but its MOBILE_POINTS bullet says '...and call out from your browser'. The copy contradicts itself.
buy-included-note uses text-[#a1a1aa] on a white card in the light theme, which is low contrast.
The Fax buy country picker is a native <select>, while Calls uses the shadcn IconSelect. This is inconsistent.

action_items: CallsBuy.js line 41: treat c.included === 'all' as 'free with every plan' (US, CA and UK are currently labelled 'extra monthly charge')

number-requests.js: replace includedIssue with planNumberIssue (or none) so request-only countries (DE, AT, CR, CY, DK, EC, PY, PE) can be a first number, and charge plan.price + phoneConfig.planAddon(planKey, country, 'local', addonSurcharge)
RequestOrder.js and the PlanPicker for res.request: show the plan + country charge breakdown and the full total (the crypto path for requests too, if one exists)
Esim.js WayPicker: add a visible selected style (border/ring/bg), e.g. a ring in the accent colour when aria-checked
Review whether the calls checkout 'Add a Texting Number' (Spenza ZIP) upsell should stay now that Spenza lives under the eSIM page
Fix the contradictory web texting card copy (texts only vs call out from browser) and the 'Mobile' label on USA MultiTEL texting results

Remove the dead ProductHero component export (it still has old 'Texting Number' copy and duplicate testids hero-order-mobile/hero-order-esim), and update the stale TextingBuy.js comment that mentions ZIP
critical_code_review_comments: phone-config.planAddon returns the surcharge for included countries when surcharge > 0, so a 'free' country with an admin add-on still costs extra. Confirm this is intended.
ProductHero.js still exports the old ProductHero, which nothing imports, and it reuses testids that OnePage also uses.
TextingBuy uses WalletPay with only onWallet, but a 'Pay with crypto' button is shown. Make sure the crypto path passes withTexting and the plan add-on.

success_rate.backend: 100% of the tested endpoints (7/7); the /numbers/request first-number path fails (found by manual check)

seed_data_creation: A UI purchase (preview dry-run) created Brazil local +551920425854 on the Basic (starter) plan for civr.uxtest@example.com. The wallet was charged $75 ($559.13 → $484.13). The number was not removed. Test reviews were shown only through a Playwright route mock; nothing was written to the DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login civr.uxtest@example.com / UxTest#2026 at /cloudivr/login (dismiss cookie-allow-all first). Plan ids: starter=Basic $50, standard=Starter $75, pro=Pro $100, business=Business $120. In the IconSelect country picker, open buy-country-select, then scroll_into_view the option [data-testid=buy-country-select-option-<code lowercase>] before clicking (with force=True it picked the wrong country). /public/reviews is empty, so quotes-strip is hidden; it was verified via route mock and sits right under product-hero. Support chat says 'Germany local: name and address, no ID documents', which matches the offer data (details=name_address), so the brief's expectation of 'ID documents' does not apply. To retest: US option label, DE request order as first number (Basic → expect 202 and $75 charged), and the eSIM picker selected style.
rca of the issue: Label bug: the catalog's included field is 'all' | 'business' | null, but the UI compares it to true. Request bug: number-requests.js was not moved from includedIssue (old rule: only plan countries can be a first number) to the new planNumberIssue/planAddon model that numbers.js and orders.js now use.
